title: Loan Repayment, EMI Auto-Debit and Foreclosure Policy
content: Loan EMIs are auto-debited from the linked repayment account via NACH mandate on the scheduled due date each month. Customers wishing to view repayment schedules, download interest certificates, check foreclosure charges, or obtain a No Objection Certificate after full repayment can access Loan Services in Mobile Banking or NetBanking, or request specialist assistance for restructuring.
